propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate chaired the weekly readiness review with partner support and regional service leads and recorded decisions in the review log.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the review chairing and record keeping.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate escalated unresolved readiness risks to the head of product operations with recommended options.
propositions.rationale: The resume names the two escalations and their handling.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate led the partner onboarding programme and held the operational readiness sign-off for product releases.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the sign-off records and the reference call all state the programme leadership and the sign-off ownership.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for partner support after each release are only partly documented in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: programme leadership and readiness sign-off, with scope approved by the product manager; do not extend it to product scope decisions.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how known limitations and hand-over conditions for partner support were documented after each release.
